summary_1line: Gandhari recounts the families’ grief after the war, and Kunti confesses to Vyasa the secret birth and abandonment of her son Karna.

image_candidates.scene_text: Blindfolded Gandhari stands with folded hands before the sage Vyasa, surrounded by grieving widows of the slain Kuru warriors.
Young Kunti watches the radiant Sun god appear in her chamber, half in the sky and half before her, blazing with a thousand rays.
A sorrowful Kunti sets the infant Karna afloat in a basket upon a river, hiding her face as the child drifts away.
